messages:
Marie (Sales): Acme procurement needs a short SIG follow-up on BCP/DR: RTO/RPO for Dedicated vs Hosted, backup cadence, failover steps, test cadence, and links to evidence. Deadline EOD Thursday. @Jordan @Claire can you marshal?
Jordan (Eng-SRE): Will do. Confirming they're buying Dedicated for prod and want Hosted comparison too? Numbers differ by deployment.
Marie (Sales): Correct — Dedicated primary. Combine into one concise page.
Neil (Infra): Tentative numbers: Dedicated: contractual uptime 99.9%+, automated node failover <5m, cross-region failover <60m. RPO: control-plane <15m; data snapshots daily default, hourly optional. Hosted: multi-AZ, regional failover to nearest healthy region; observed failover 10-45m depending on warm capacity. No contractual RTO for self-serve. RPO default 24h.
Claire (Security): Backups encrypted at rest. Private customers may use customer-managed KMS; hosted/dedicated use our managed KMS (AES-256). Default retention 30d; extended retention available. We run quarterly restore drills (sampled) and annual Dedicated full DR exercises. Can provide most recent test dates.
Jordan (Eng-SRE): I'll paste a short runbook excerpt for the one-pager: 
```
1) Alert triggers from heartbeats/health checks.
2) Promote warm secondary -> update routing and DNS TTLs.
3) Validate KV/store sync, warm caches, run smoke tests.
4) If error rate >5% -> scale + on-call escalation.
5) Capture primary state, snapshot, and start post-mortem.
```
Claire (Security): Also call out: RBAC during failover, break-glass audit logs, signed change records, and SOC2 controls covering change management.
Alex (Sales-ops): I'll assemble the one-page doc and attach links. Need redacted restore report and links to SLA/docs.
Jordan (Eng-SRE): Links: SLA: https://redwood.example.com/legal/sla, Backups: https://redwood.example.com/docs/backups, DR redacted summary: https://redwood.example.com/internal/dr-tests/2025-q1-redacted
Claire (Security): I'll send a redacted restore report via PM. Reminder: redact any internal IPs/creds.
Marie (Sales): Thanks team. Alex and I will finalize and send to Acme. If procurement asks for formal attestation, flag legal. :pray:
